newsitem.title: USA: Commerce Bancorp to buy Chesley & Cline.
newsitem.headline: Commerce Bancorp to buy Chesley & Cline.

text.p: Commerce Bancorp said Monday it had signed a letter of intent to buy New Jersey insurance brokerage Chesley & Cline Inc.
Commerce said it will issue about 215,000 shares in the acquisition, which it said will be accretive to earnings in 1997.

Chesley & Cline will be part of Commerce National Insurance Services Inc, which Commerce Bancorp formed to acquire Buckelew & Associates and Keystone National Co Inc, both of New Jersey. The combined firm will offer commercial, personal and employee benefit insurance services in Southern New Jersey and metropolitan Philadelphia, the company said.
